name: Thu Thuy
headline: Brand designer for hospitality, resorts & real estate.
intro: I'm Thu Thuy (you can also call me Rin), a senior graphic designer with 10 years of experience creating brand identities, key visuals and campaigns for hotels, resorts and real estate projects.
about: Over the past 10 years I've worked with high-end hotel and resort brands as well as real estate projects, creating designs that look beautiful and also express each brand's identity and values.

What I love most is turning ideas into inspiring visuals that help people connect with a space or service from the very first glance. To me, every project is a story of its own, and design is the art of telling that story through a visual language.
contactText: If the work above is the kind of thing you're looking for, I'd love to hear about it.
seoDescription: Portfolio of Thu Thuy (Rin), a Hanoi-based senior graphic designer with 10 years of experience in brand identity, key visuals and campaigns for hospitality, resorts and real estate.
